findings.summary: The page renders nothing while the query is loading (no skeleton/spinner), so users see a blank page after the header on first load, unlike the sibling OnboardingPage which shows a loading indicator.
findings.fix:
Between the header and the metrics section, render a loading state when q.isLoading is true (e.g. the LoadingScreen pattern or a `

جارٍ تحميل التقارير…

` matching OnboardingPage line 36).

findings.summary: There is no error state; if the query fails, `d` is undefined and the page silently shows only the header with no feedback, diverging from the app pattern that renders an EmptyState/error banner on q.isError.
findings.fix: Add `{q.isError ? <EmptyState title="تعذر تحميل التقارير" description={q.error instanceof Error ? q.error.message : 'تحقق من الصلاحيات'} /> : null}` (import EmptyState), mirroring OnboardingPage line 37.

findings.summary: The export button reimplements the .btn-primary style inline (`inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-brand px-4 py-2.5 font-black text-white disabled:opacity-50`) instead of reusing the shared .btn-primary class used by sibling pages.
findings.fix: Replace the inline utility classes on the export button with `className="btn-primary"` (as OnboardingPage line 35 does), keeping only the onClick/disabled props and the icon.

findings.summary: All five MetricCards use the identical generic FileBarChart icon, giving no visual differentiation between metrics and making the icon decorative noise rather than informative.
findings.fix: Assign distinct lucide icons per metric (e.g. Users for الموظفون, UserCheck for النشطون, Inbox/ClipboardList for الطلبات, Clock for مراجعات الحضور, Target for KPI) to match the differentiated-icon convention used in other summary sections.

findings.summary: The whole component and its download handler are collapsed onto a single minified line, which is inconsistent with the readable multi-line formatting of every other page in the feature folder.
findings.fix: Reformat the file with normal line breaks/indentation (one statement per line, JSX broken across lines) to match OnboardingPage and the rest of the codebase; this is purely stylistic with no logic change.
